name: modbus
title: Modbus: libmodbus vs rodbus/tokio-modbus
summary: Differential + sanitizer fuzzing of libmodbus (C, the target) against a Rust Modbus codec (rodbus or tokio-modbus) on the ADU/PDU decode path (RTU and TCP). Stateful trace op feeds a request then its response so response parsing is exercised against the pending request.
